about: E03 (ffw-q2p) host-side cases.  Expected values are written independently of tests/e03/abi.py. REAL = committed QEMU transcripts/receipt; PLANTED = one changed line in a real transcript; SYNTHETIC = a line added or changed because no real source exists; BLOCKED = required, unverifiable now.

cases.title: Probes for eventfd2, timerfd, accept4, getrandom, futex, TLS and threads
cases.reason: the contract and the bead name them but no guest probe emits them (abi.py lists them as unprobed)

cases.title: Timer wakeup under repeated interrupts, signal delivery and shutdown, allocator alignment/failure/peak memory, dependency-graph atomics
cases.reason: bead section 4 requires them; the guest probes none of these (it probes one 32-bit atomic, a monotonic clock resolution and no signals)

cases.title: Socket bind/send/receive and truncated-datagram reporting, readiness of audio-like character devices, reactor wakeup, filesystem sync and atomic rename
cases.reason: bead section 4 requires them; the guest only creates a UDP socket and polls a pipe

invariants.text: Syscall result to errno mapping, per ABI
EINTR and EAGAIN are transient and never mean unsupported
Short I/O is a normal result; a full or zero count is not a short write
invariants.note: the host can only judge the guest's PARTIAL_WRITE line; no committed transcript has one

invariants.text: Time-width boundaries (tv_nsec, 32-bit counters)
Overflow of probe integers
Alignment boundaries (allocator, atomics operand)
invariants.note: newc archive alignment is covered elsewhere (scripts/test/test_support/newc_case.py); the guest probes no allocator alignment

invariants.text: Absent poll and entropy capabilities
Absent thread, TLS, futex, eventfd and timerfd capabilities
Unsupported features return explicit capability failures (ENOSYS in the profile ABI)
An intentionally missing capability is a classified non-pass, never an overall green suite
Guest identity and provenance are recorded and checked
invariants.note: kernel identity and artifact digests are checked; target triple, compiler, linker and libc are not recorded

invariants.text: CPU emulation, matching guest, non-matching guest and unavailable guest are distinguished
A non-matching kernel can never make a profile supported
Exact-version stock-kernel guests exist for the stock profiles
Each probe is reported independently, not as one broad pass
Nonzero exit when a required capability is absent or ambiguous
The guest's own errno numbering and self-tests gate the transcript
An independent validator agrees with this one on real and planted transcripts
Evidence artifacts are identified by digest and consistent with the committed receipt
Per-probe output is preserved
invariants.note: each probe's raw line is retained in the result; separate stdout/stderr capture belongs to capture_guest in the root's runner

invariants.text: Cancellation, timeout and restart of the QEMU run
invariants.note: the process-group capture, timeout and kill of the guest are toolchain/src/run-qemu-verification.py::capture_guest (root, E07); this host-side classifier only reads a finished transcript. A cancelled or timed-out run leaves a truncated transcript, which E03-CLASS-030 and E03-CLASS-031 classify as an unavailable guest.

invariants.text: The case file and the runner themselves are coherent and cannot pass vacuously
Socket I/O semantics, device readiness, reactor wakeup and filesystem durability
